text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Rice Shower gave it her absolute 
all on the stage of the Japanese Derby, 
she was unable to catch Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to challenge Mihono Bourbon once 
more, Rice Shower sets her sights on the 
next long-distance race, the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For Rice Shower, a true stayer, the days 
leading up to her defining race have 
begun.
